command_argv:
import base64
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys

path = sys.argv[1]
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
d = json.loads(text)

def canonical(obj):
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False).encode()

def dag_identity(obj):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(canonical(obj)).digest()
    cid = "b" + base64.b32encode(b"\x01\xa9\x02\x12\x20" + digest).decode().lower().rstrip("=")
    return cid, digest.hex()

def raw_identity(raw):
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).digest()
    cid = "b" + base64.b32encode(b"\x01\x55\x12\x20" + digest).decode().lower().rstrip("=")
    return cid, digest.hex()

def check_receipt(receipt):
    projection = {k: v for k, v in receipt.items() if k not in ("receipt_cid", "receipt_identity")}
    cid, sha = dag_identity(projection)
    assert receipt["receipt_cid"] == cid
    assert receipt["receipt_identity"] == "sha256:" + sha

assert text.endswith("\n") and not text.endswith("\n\n")
assert ("PLACE" + "HOLDER_") not in text
assert d["schema"] == "pgir-task-result@1" and d["task_id"] == "PGIR-005"
eb = d["evidence_bundle"]
for receipt in eb["test_receipts"] + eb["source_binding_receipts"] + [eb["capability_receipt"], eb["artifact_validation_receipt"]]:
    check_receipt(receipt)
for repair in eb["prerequisite_dispositions"]:
    projection = {k: v for k, v in repair.items() if k not in ("proposal_cid", "proposal_identity")}
    cid, sha = dag_identity(projection)
    assert repair["proposal_cid"] == cid
    assert repair["proposal_identity"] == "sha256:" + sha
bundle_projection = {k: v for k, v in eb.items() if k not in ("bundle_cid", "bundle_identity")}
cid, sha = dag_identity(bundle_projection)
assert eb["bundle_cid"] == cid and eb["bundle_identity"] == "sha256:" + sha
assert d["artifact"]["content_scope"] == "/evidence_bundle"
assert d["artifact"]["evidence_bundle_cid"] == cid
assert d["artifact"]["evidence_bundle_identity"] == "sha256:" + sha
cid, sha = dag_identity(d["result_projection"])
assert d["result_cid"] == cid and d["result_identity"] == "sha256:" + sha
summary_projection = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k not in ("summary_cid", "summary_identity")}
cid, sha = dag_identity(summary_projection)
assert d["summary_cid"] == cid and d["summary_identity"] == "sha256:" + sha
decoded_logs = {}
for log_id, log in eb["embedded_logs"].items():
    raw = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(log["payload"], validate=True))
    cid, sha = raw_identity(raw)
    assert len(raw) == log["uncompressed_byte_count"]
    assert log["cid"] == cid and log["sha256"] == sha
    decoded_logs[log_id] = re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m", "", raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
tests = {r["category"]: r for r in eb["test_receipts"]}
assert set(tests) == {"accelerator", "datasets", "focused-validation"}
expected = {
    "accelerator": (360, 360, 0, 0, 0),
    "datasets": (818, 801, 2, 2, 13),
    "focused-validation": (31, 31, 0, 0, 0)
}
for name, values in expected.items():
    outcome = tests[name]["outcome"]
    observed = (outcome["collected"], outcome["passed"], outcome["failed"], outcome["skipped"], outcome["errors"])
    assert observed == values
    assert outcome["collected"] == outcome["passed"] + outcome["failed"] + outcome["skipped"] + outcome["errors"]
for category, log_id in (
    ("accelerator", "accelerator_stdout"),
    ("datasets", "datasets_stdout"),
    ("focused-validation", "focused_validation_stdout"),
):
    assert tests[category]["outcome"]["summary"] in decoded_logs[log_id]
accelerator_match = re.search(r"(\d+) passed, (\d+) warning", decoded_logs["accelerator_stdout"])
datasets_match = re.search(r"(\d+) failed, (\d+) passed, (\d+) skipped, (\d+) errors", decoded_logs["datasets_stdout"])
focused_match = re.search(r"(\d+) passed, (\d+) warning", decoded_logs["focused_validation_stdout"])
assert accelerator_match and tuple(map(int, accelerator_match.groups())) == (tests["accelerator"]["outcome"]["passed"], tests["accelerator"]["outcome"]["warnings"])
assert datasets_match and tuple(map(int, datasets_match.groups())) == (tests["datasets"]["outcome"]["failed"], tests["datasets"]["outcome"]["passed"], tests["datasets"]["outcome"]["skipped"], tests["datasets"]["outcome"]["errors"])
assert focused_match and tuple(map(int, focused_match.groups())) == (tests["focused-validation"]["outcome"]["passed"], tests["focused-validation"]["outcome"]["warnings"])
dataset_outcome = tests["datasets"]["outcome"]
failure = dataset_outcome["first_failed_assertion"]
setup = dataset_outcome["first_setup_cause"]
assert failure and setup
for field in ("expression", "node_id", "location", "snapshot_value", "live_expected_value"):
    assert str(failure[field]) in decoded_logs["datasets_stdout"]
for field in ("observed_message", "node_id", "raise_location", "portable_missing_path"):
    assert str(setup[field]) in decoded_logs["datasets_stdout"]
assert all(node_id in decoded_logs["datasets_stdout"] for node_id in dataset_outcome["error_node_ids"])
assert all(item["node_id"] in decoded_logs["datasets_stdout"] and item["message"] in decoded_logs["datasets_stdout"] for item in dataset_outcome["additional_failures"])
sources = {r["repository_id"]: r for r in eb["source_binding_receipts"]}
for repository_id, log_id in (
    ("SRC-ACCEL-AUTH-1", "accelerator_source_binding_stdout"),
    ("SRC-DATASETS-AUTH-1", "datasets_source_binding_stdout"),
):
    source = sources[repository_id]
    observed = source["observed"]
    source_log = decoded_logs[log_id]
    assert observed["checkout_head"] in source_log
    assert observed["origin"] in source_log
    assert ("tracked_changes=" + str(observed["tracked_changes"]) + " untracked=" + str(observed["untracked_paths"])) in source_log
    assert "base_present=128" in source_log and "base_is_ancestor=128" in source_log
    assert observed["working_tree_content_identity_sealed"] is False
repairs = eb["prerequisite_dispositions"]
assert [r["category"] for r in repairs] == ["semantic_cid_drift", "missing_lean_runtime_export", "absent_hammer_environment_lock"]
assert all(r["cannot_weaken_gate"] and r["bounded_repair_task"]["revision"] == "separate_task_revision_required" for r in repairs)
assert all(r["bounded_repair_task"]["scope"]["repository_id"] == "SRC-DATASETS-AUTH-1" for r in repairs)
assert d["allowed_effects"] == [{"path": path, "effect": "create qualification evidence summary"}]
assert d["prohibited_effects_observed"] == []
assert d["rollback"]["protected_files_touched"] is False
print("PGIR-005 artifact validation passed")
